svg.title: All 832 MAC units
svg.desc: A grid of 32 spatial lanes by 26 output channels shows every physical MAC once. Input samples broadcast across a row; channel weights broadcast down a column. The array is reused for all 32 image rows; it is not a systolic neighbor-to-neighbor array.
svg.text: One grid computes one image row. Reuse this same grid for image rows y = 0 through 31.
Initialize acc[p,c] = bias[c]. For each of 27 window terms: acc[p,c] += sample[p] × weight[c].
After pipeline drain: emit 832 row results in 8 groups of 104 (4 positions × 26 channels).
Illustrative MAC: bias 5; input 12 and weight -3 → product -36 → updated accumulator -31.
Input and weight broadcasts are shared. This is not a neighbor-to-neighbor systolic array.
